verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a vector database service, since a database could emit outbound callbacks on events such as collection or point changes. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks or any event subscription mechanism. The items cover search, filtering, multitenancy, snapshots, security, client libraries, agent skills and an MCP server, none of which are webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
